title:
Sip with us at
Astray Bar.
lede: Our favourite place to host public events. Astray pours up bottomless drinks packages (their mocktails are absurd) and the poutine - chips, cheese curds, gravy - is genuinely the best post-painting dinner in Geelong.

perks.heading: Bottomless
perks.body: Drinks package included with paint & sip ticket - wines, beers & mocktails.

perks.heading: Poutine
perks.body: Chips, cheese curds, gravy. Stay for dinner after - it slaps.

perks.heading: The studio
perks.body: Easels lined up along the bar wall. Lighting? Vibes? Sorted.

perks.heading: Geelong CBD
perks.body: Walking distance from the waterfront. Easy parking nearby.
